criteria.description: The existing inventory-stock catalog/on-demand API expose exactly ten current persisted-item fields, the inventory_items projection and tenant rails already exist, and the worker lacks only the scheduled source/branch.
criteria.limitations: The on-demand report is a separate bounded path; scheduled delivery must preserve its current-value semantics without changing API/SPA behavior or adding historical valuation.

criteria.description: Focused RED tests are specified to reject absent source/branch, permissive filters, foreign or malformed rows, unsafe derived values and overflow before implementation.
criteria.limitations: The new source, scheduled assertions, disposable PostgreSQL execution, independent review and reconciliation remain open after this gate.

gaps: The scheduled inventory-stock source, worker branch/bootstrap wiring, RED/GREEN tests and real process proof are not complete at gate creation.
The report derives a bounded current operational value; historical/as-of valuation, lots, movements and invoices remain outside scope.
Independent review, global non-promotion retest and final reconciliation remain required.
conditions: Keep the result limited to the authenticated tenant-scoped scheduled read path over inventory_items and the exact ten-field catalog contract.
Do not add migrations, joins, CRUD changes, historical valuation, lots, movements, invoices, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment, backfill or release acceptance.
Keep CVG-004/global ERP IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL and promotion BLOCKED.

authority.actor: Ricardo (repository owner), via explicit continuation request and original consolidation brief
authority.scope: CVG-004 bounded tenant-scoped scheduled inventory-stock report source through the real worker
authority.decision: Authorize only reversible inventory-module and worker implementation plus focused and disposable PostgreSQL/process verification of the existing read-only inventory-stock schedule. The source may read the persisted inventory_items projection through the existing explicit tenant-safe source, expose only the ten existing catalog fields after deriving current stockValue and reorderStatus from the persisted quantity, reorder level and unit cost, apply case-insensitive SKU/name search and strict inclusive UTC createdAt date filters, deterministic name/id order and a 10,000-row bound, and fail closed on missing/foreign/malformed or unsafe derived output. Preserve existing durable schedule execution/export audit and one-shot semantics. Exclude lots, movements, invoices, historical/as-of valuation, CRUD, migrations, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment, external mutation, backfill and release acceptance.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before changing inventory_items schema/RLS or numeric/timestamp semantics, adding joins/fields/filters, changing worker schedule/audit behavior, adding historical/lot/movement/invoice/valuation behavior, provider delivery, target operations or production behavior.

next_action: Write and run the intentional inventory-stock source, worker and real process RED tests, then implement the smallest bounded tenant-aware persisted source and PostgreSQL proof.
revalidation_triggers: Changes to inventory_items schema, account RLS/FORCE-RLS or persisted quantity/cost/timestamp semantics
Changes to worker bootstrap, schedule claiming, report execution/export/audit or one-shot failure behavior
Expansion beyond scheduled inventory-stock or the existing ten-field contract
